title: A neuron-specific microexon ablates the novel DNA-binding function of a histone H3K4me0 reader PHF21A
authors: Robert S. Porter; Masayoshi Nagai; Sojin An; Maria C. Gavilan; Yumie Murata-Nakamura; Katherine M. Bonefas; Bo Zhou; Olivier Dionne; Jeru Manoj Manuel; Joannie St-Germain; Liam Browning; Benoit Laurent; Uhn-Soo Cho; Shigeki Iwase
one_liner_zh: 该文研究神经元特异性微外显子剪接改变PHF21A的DNA结合功能，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且以实验为主、无AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: How cell-type-specific chromatin landscapes emerge and progress during metazoan ontogenesis remains an important question. Transcription factors are expressed in a cell-type-specific manner and recruit chromatin-regulatory machinery to specific genomic loci. In contrast, chromatin-regulatory proteins are expressed broadly and are assumed to exert the same intrinsic function across cell types. However, human genetics studies have revealed an unexpected vulnerability of neurodevelopment to chromatin factor mutations with unknown mechanisms. Here, we report that 14 chromatin regulators undergo evolutionary-conserved neuron-specific splicing events involving microexons. Of the 14 chromatin regulators, two are integral components of a histone H3K4 demethylase complex; the catalytic subunit LSD1 and an H3K4me0-reader protein PHF21A adopt neuron-specific forms. We found that canonical PHF21A (PHF21A-c) binds to DNA by AT-hook motif, and the neuronal counterpart PHF21A-n lacks this DNA-binding function yet maintains H3K4me0 recognition intact. In-vitro reconstitution of the canonical and neuronal PHF21A-LSD1 complexes identified the neuronal complex as a hypomorphic H3K4 demethylating machinery with reduced nucleosome engagement. Furthermore, an autism-associated PHF21A missense mutation, 1285 G>A, at the last nucleotide of the common exon immediately upstream of the neuronal microexon led to impaired splicing of PHF21A -n. Thus, ubiquitous chromatin regulatory complexes exert unique intrinsic functions in neurons via alternative splicing of their subunits and potentially contribute to faithful human brain development.
abstract_zh: 细胞类型特异性的染色质景观如何在后生动物个体发育过程中出现和进展，仍是一个重要问题。转录因子以细胞类型特异性方式表达，并招募染色质调控机制至特定基因组位点。相比之下，染色质调控蛋白广泛表达，并被认为在不同细胞类型中发挥相同的内在功能。然而，人类遗传学研究揭示了神经发育对染色质因子突变存在意想不到的脆弱性，其机制尚不清楚。在此，我们报告14种染色质调控因子经历进化保守的神经元特异性剪接事件，涉及微外显子。在这14种染色质调控因子中，两种是组蛋白H3K4去甲基化酶复合物的核心组分；催化亚基LSD1和H3K4me0阅读蛋白PHF21A采用神经元特异性形式。我们发现，经典PHF21A（PHF21A-c）通过AT-hook基序结合DNA，而神经元对应形式PHF21A-n缺乏此DNA结合功能，但保持H3K4me0识别完整。体外重构经典和神经元PHF21A-LSD1复合物，鉴定出神经元复合物为低效的H3K4去甲基化机制，其核小体结合能力降低。此外，一个自闭症相关的PHF21A错义突变，1285 G>A，位于神经元微外显子紧邻上游的共同外显子最后一个核苷酸，导致PHF21A-n剪接受损。因此，普遍存在的染色质调控复合物通过其亚基的选择性剪接，在神经元中发挥独特的内在功能，并可能有助于人类大脑的忠实发育。
